notes.title: Check out our newest game: BIT.TRIP RERUNNER!
notes.content:
BUY or WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER features the RUNNER MAKER level editor tool, empowering players to craft their own challenging levels. Additionally, the game introduces the exciting MUSIC MAKER, enabling players to compose personalized soundtracks for their gameplay. This innovative feature adds a new layer of creativity, allowing players to shape both the visual and auditory aspects of their BIT.TRIP RUNNER experience.

The power of the MUSIC MAKER

 Brave 150+ obstacle-filled levels based on the classic games – each more challenging than the last.
 Dive head-first into a trippy new art style powered by Unreal 5.
 Enjoy a fully remixed soundtrack at unhealthy volume levels.
 Create and share the levels of your dreams with RUNNER MAKER.
 Uncover gaming artifacts in the Historical Gallery – with fun nods to the original game!

notes.title: Build 108 released!
notes.content:
A new build has just been released containing numerous bug fixes and gameplay balances. It also features a bit of extra content, as our way of saying, "thanks for your patience while we work out some kinks."

We hope you enjoy the newer and improveder version of Shütshimi, and if you're enjoying yourselves, please - write a review, tell a friend, share it on social media, the works! We'd appreciate it ♥

For a complete list of changes, read this handy list:

    The effects of multiple hats have been adjusted.
    Toetag Stanley can no longer be challenged in Boss Rush before being unlocked.
    Killing a boss and dying in the same update frame no longer locks up controls.
    The upgraded mucus launcher's power has been adjusted.
    The laser beam's power has been adjusted. (Base and upgraded)
    The Pacifish awardment has been adjusted to allow for bouncy castles.
    The difficulty of multiplayer has been adjusted.
    Dave has escaped.
    Thunderstorm effects in Mild VFX have been adjusted.
    "Reviving" fish can no longer bump into living players.
    Display logic for mid-wave info bubbles has been adjusted.
    Leaderboards have been moved to the Title screen.
    Leaderboards can now be paged through using the "Friends" filter.
    Fixed Ludum Double Dare awardment.
    Fixed various hat and awardment descriptions.
    Fixed Round-end awardments being earnable on game-over.
    Fixed desync issues with ad-hoc joining.
    Somehow broke controller remapping's safety settings, allowing brave players to map a single button to multiple actions.
